title: Dimension of affine iterated function systems on $\mathbb{R}^d$
summary: Let $\{f_i(x)=M_ix+a_i\}_{i\in I}$ be an affine iterated function system on $\mathbb{R}^d$ with attractor $Λ$, and let $μ$ be an associated self-affine measure. Assume that the $M_i$ generate a Zariski dense subgroup of $\mathrm{GL}_d(\mathbb{R})$. Under the strong open set condition, we show that $\dim_{\mathrm{H}}Λ$ equals the affinity dimension and that $\dim_{\mathrm{H}}μ$ equals the Lyapunov dimension.
